name: jp_fsa_actions_search
description: Search the Japan Financial Services Agency's collection of administrative dispositions against financial firms (行政処分事例集: business improvement orders, business suspension orders, registration revocations and similar, issued by the agency and the Local Finance Bureaus since FY2002; ~2,800 rows covering securities and investment firms, banks, insurers and agencies, money lenders, payment and prepaid issuers): by company name in Japanese or English and/or 13-digit corporate number. Each hit is the agency's own row: fiscal year, announcement date, law cited, type and content of the order, main cause and trigger. Match is exact or partial after Unicode folding and corporate-form words are dropped. No hit means no row for that name in the collection as published on `data_as_of` (it covers dispositions the agency announced; Securities and Exchange Surveillance Commission recommendations and cases handled only by other agencies are not in it). Rows that name individuals are not served. Example: name="野村證券".

name.description: Company name in Japanese or English. Provide this or corporate_number.

corporate_number.description: 13-digit 法人番号. Only entries since 2016 carry one, so a number with no hit is weaker than a name with no hit.

action_type.description: Optional filter on the order type, e.g. 業務停止命令, 登録取消し, 業務改善命令.

limit.description: Maximum matches returned (1-50, default 10); `total_matches` always gives the full count.
